trust: Distinct live nodes authenticate the current checkpoint and account heads; retained content-addressed BOCs supply only pruned history. The resolver checks the complete hash-linked ancestry to that live head. Same code in a separate process, not an independent implementation. Endpoints share one operator.
supersedes: Any direct-node provenance emitted automatically by the older wrapper; verifier reads.endpoints is authoritative.
mutations: No state override, truncated history, synthesized transaction, recognition bypass or validator restart.
